description: This source file implements convolution operations within the PyTorch framework, including utility functions for shape checks, backend selection (cuDNN, MIOpen, MKLDNN, etc.), and various convolution variants (standard, transpose, depthwise, grouped). It handles both regular tensors and symbolic dimensions (SymInt), facilitating flexible and optimized convolution computations on CPU and CUDA devices.

classes.name: ConvParams<T>
classes.description: Template class encapsulating convolution parameters such as stride, padding, dilation, groups, and flags like transposed, benchmark, deterministic, cudnn_enabled, and allow_tf32. Provides methods for shape validation, backend-specific decisions, and shape transformations for 1D, 2D, and 3D convolutions.
